page.overview:
Who is Elephants?

Ancient Psychic Tandem War Elephant Mama Trunks Tail Tufts Elephant Summoners Ele-fly (hybrid)

Elephants are a species of animal that appears in the Adventure Time series. One of the most prominent members of this species is Tree Trunks, who commonly appears through the series. Two elephants similar to Tree Trunks include her mother and her gender-swapped version. Another common elephant that appears throughout the series is the "Ancient Psychic Tandem War Elephant", who was wished into existence by Finn and Jake in the episode "The Limit".

A group of Elephant Summoners summoned a being known as the Ele-fly using the "Ele-fly Call" in the episode "Whipple the Happy Dragon".
